description: Keyword registry for the RQ3 topics selected in docs/TOPIC_SELECTION.md. High precision over recall: terms must name the issue, not a mood or a party.
changes: 1.1.0 (2026-10-18, after the first coverage run and a 100-post spot check): precision fixes for all topics (exclude_phrases; health without 'pandemia' and 'hospitalari-'; economy adjectives only in fixed phrases, no 'economias') and 'pobreza energetica' added to household_costs. Before/after counts in docs/TOPIC_SELECTION.md.

1.2.0 (2026-10-18, after the manual spot check): accented verb forms removed before accents are stripped ('paró', 'empleó'), and 'inquilino de la Moncloa' and evacuated homes added to exclude_phrases.
normalization: URLs removed, lower-cased, exclude_accented removed, accents removed, whitespace collapsed, exclude_phrases removed. Each group is compiled as \b(?:p1|p2|...)\b and searched in the normalized text.
assignment: A post gets a topic when exactly one topic matches, review_needed when several match, and other when none matches.

cis_categories: La crisis económica, los problemas de índole económica
Los problemas relacionados con la calidad del empleo
topics.rationale: Growth, unemployment, jobs and wages. Taxes and pensions are separate CIS categories and are left out; prices and inflation belong to household_costs.

cis_categories: La subida de tarifas energéticas, crisis energética
topics.rationale: What households pay: housing and the cost of living. Squatting is property and security, not cost, and is left out.

prices: (precio|precios|factura|facturas|recibo|tarifa|tarifas) de (la luz|la electricidad|la energia|el gas|los alimentos|la cesta|la compra|los carburantes|la gasolina|el combustible)

cis_categories: Los peligros para la salud: COVID-19
topics.rationale: The health system and public health, including the pandemic.

cis_categories: Crisis con Marruecos. Fronteras de Ceuta y Melilla
topics.rationale: Immigration, asylum and border control. Bare 'fronteras' is left out because it also means 'abroad'.
Corruption crimes and the main corruption cases of the period. Judicial terms without a corruption crime (imputado, banquillo) are left out.
